solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] 

The pattern followed here is: 

BI 2 is related to EF 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90e5316172d4a82294e03ec0e9edffcc6a6d6f097a89029f8649340e5459bad8.png] 

And,

KR 8 is related to NO 11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdffa16ccb824710ea216a4123b8b657e85cfe9a704c1e289d4ddb90b0babffe.png]

TI 3 related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd718d3c5ee16a3c9edf9ef4d1e171b776fef9c36c4eb8e9bf42529d9bc4383d.png]
